## Discovery & Translational Science

* **Hematopoietic stem cell gene therapy corrects neurodegenerative MPS IIIA** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42798182/)
  * A case study demonstrated clinical and biochemical correction in a patient with neurodegenerative Mucopolysaccharidosis IIIA using hematopoietic stem cell gene therapy.

* **[Biotech]** **Preclinical evaluation of oncolytic vaccinia virus candidate GC001** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42791319/)
  * Investigators evaluated the efficacy and safety profile of GC001, an oncolytic vaccinia virus engineered to express STRIP1 shRNA.

* **Perioperative ctDNA predicts recurrence in resectable gastric and GEJ adenocarcinoma** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42791456/)
  * Analysis of circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) for molecular residual disease (MRD) provided a trial-ready framework for post-surgical treatment adaptation and recurrence prediction in localized gastric and gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.

* **PCSK9 inhibitors linked to slower eGFR decline in high-risk CKD** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42791189/)
  * Exploratory evidence suggests that patients at high risk of chronic kidney disease (CKD) progression experience a reduced rate of estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) decline when treated with PCSK9 inhibitors.

* **Pharmacogenomic and metabolomic profile predicts valproic acid response and toxicity** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42791380/)
  * An integrated metabolomic and pharmacogenomic analysis identified predictive biomarkers for valproic acid efficacy and drug-induced hepatotoxicity in pediatric epilepsy patients.

* **GLP-1 receptor agonist safety analysis evaluates hepatotoxicity risk** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42791090/)
  * A clinical review detailed the presentation and potential risk factors associated with glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist-induced hepatotoxicity.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Biotech]** **Acadia's remlifanserin misses primary endpoint in Phase 2 Alzheimer's psychosis study** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/novo-nanexa-acadia-remlifanserin-nektar-lilly-onswik-welireg/831346/)
  * Remlifanserin narrowly missed statistical significance in a Phase 2 trial measuring reductions in hallucinations and delusions in patients with Alzheimer’s disease psychosis.
  * Despite the missed endpoint, Acadia plans to continue patient enrollment in two ongoing Phase 3 trials, citing modest efficacy trends, secondary benefits, and a favorable safety profile.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Biotech]** **Kodiak Sciences set to report Phase 3 DAYBREAK data in wet AMD** [@BioStocks on X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2103626660126060595)
  * Kodiak Sciences announced it will report topline data on Monday from its pivotal Phase 3 DAYBREAK study evaluating Zenkuda and KSI-501 in patients with wet age-related macular degeneration (AMD).

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Big Pharma]** **FDA approves Eli Lilly's once-weekly basal insulin Onswik** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/25/biotech-news-lilly-wins-approval-for-weekly-insulin-shot/) | [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/novel-drug-approvals-fda/novel-drug-approvals-2026)
  * The FDA approved Onswik (insulin efsitora alfa-gobe), a once-weekly basal insulin injection to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes.
  * The long-acting formulation serves as an alternative to daily long-acting basal insulin injections.

* **[Biotech]** **FDA approves Incyte and Mirum's Atebrioz for fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/fda-approves-third-treatment-fibrodysplasia-ossificans-progressiva) | [@BioStocks on X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2103623715116204352)
  * The FDA approved Atebrioz (zilurgisertib, 100 mg once daily) to reduce new heterotopic ossification volume in adult and pediatric patients aged 12 and older with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP).
  * Approval was supported by Phase 3 trial data (NCT05090891) showing an average 3.2 cm³ decrease in total new heterotopic ossification at Week 24 with Atebrioz compared to a 24.6 cm³ increase in the placebo arm.

* **[Big Pharma]** **FDA approves Roche's Gazyva for idiopathic nephrotic syndrome** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/fda-approves-drug-treat-idiopathic-nephrotic-syndrome-patients-2-years-and-older)
  * The FDA approved Gazyva (obinutuzumab) to reduce relapse risk in pediatric (aged 2 and older) and adult patients with frequently relapsing or steroid-dependent idiopathic nephrotic syndrome in remission.
  * Approval was based on the open-label, randomized Phase 3 INSHORE trial (NCT05627557) comparing IV Gazyva to oral mycophenolate mofetil.

* **[Big Pharma]** **FDA expands Eli Lilly's Olumiant to pediatric alopecia areata** [@BioStocks on X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2103627202176667955)
  * The FDA approved Olumiant (baricitinib) for pediatric patients 12 years of age and older suffering from severe alopecia areata.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Merck pulls FDA filing for ifinatamab deruxtecan** [@JacobPlieth on X](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2103593203945378208)
  * Unconfirmed reports indicate Merck ($MRK) has withdrawn its regulatory application for the antibody-drug conjugate ifinatamab deruxtecan (ifinatamab-dxd).

* **FDA Advisory Committee to evaluate Sydnexis's atropine formulation for pediatric myopia** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/advisory-committees/advisory-committee-calendar/october-30-2026-dermatologic-and-ophthalmic-drugs-advisory-committee-meeting-announcement-10302026)
  * The FDA scheduled an October 30, 2026 meeting of the Dermatologic and Ophthalmic Drugs Advisory Committee to review Sydnexis's NDA 219694 for atropine sulfate ophthalmic solution 0.01%, aimed at slowing myopia progression in children aged 3 and older.

* **FDA issues warning letters and supplement contamination alerts** [FDA Warning Letter](http://www.fda.gov/inspections-compliance-enforcement-and-criminal-investigations/warning-letters/fairygene-inc-726976-07312026) | [FDA Health Fraud](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/medication-health-fraud-notifications/candy-power-man-may-be-harmful-due-hidden-ingredient)
  * The FDA issued warning letters to FairyGene, Inc. for manufacturing unapproved/misbranded OTC dermatological products (FROYA, Norse, Primal Viking) and CGMP violations, and to Lico Industries / American Towelette Company for CGMP non-compliance.
  * The agency alerted consumers that unapproved OTC male enhancement products, including Candy Power For Man, Miracle Power of King Kong Honey, and Vital Honey, contain undeclared tadalafil.

## Business & Strategy

* **[Big Pharma]** **Novo Nordisk strikes $1.32B long-acting drug delivery deal with Nanexa** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/novo-nanexa-acadia-remlifanserin-nektar-lilly-onswik-welireg/831346/)
  * Novo Nordisk partnered with Swedish biotech Nanexa in a deal worth up to €1.165B (~$1.32B) to leverage its "PharmaShell" drug delivery platform.
  * Nanexa will receive €615M in upfront and milestone payments to develop monthly or quarterly long-acting formulations across up to five cardiometabolic and obesity programs.

* **[Biotech]** **Nektar Therapeutics wins legal dispute against Eli Lilly** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/novo-nanexa-acadia-remlifanserin-nektar-lilly-onswik-welireg/831346/)
  * Nektar Therapeutics prevailed in a 2023 lawsuit against former partner Eli Lilly, which alleged Lilly neglected an autoimmune candidate co-developed by the companies following an acquisition.

* **Biotech IPO activity trends toward larger, late-stage clinical raises** [@andrewpannu on X](https://x.com/andrewpannu/status/2103480904341484018)
  * Global biotech IPO activity has reached ~$9.1B across 43 offerings in 2026, with average US IPO deal sizes rising ~68% to ~$314M compared to 2025.
  * Public investor appetite remains focused on Phase 2/3 clinical-stage developers, particularly within immunology and inflammation (I&I), with 67% of US listings trading above their IPO price.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Novo Nordisk stock drops 8% following capital markets strategy presentation** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/novo-nordisk-share-price-ai-drug-discovery/831366/)
  * Novo Nordisk shares fell to ~$38, down approximately 70% from mid-2024 peaks, following a capital markets day outlining plans to launch five multi-blockbusters by 2030 and reach $23B in peak sales by 2035.
  * Market pressure stems from compounding pharmacy competition, US price erosion, clinical setbacks, and impending GLP-1 patent expirations.

## Public Health & Policy

* **UN agency signs sub-licensing deals for generic versions of Roche flu drug** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/09/25/roche-xofluza-influenza-treatment-agreements/)
  * A UN-backed public health organization executed sub-licensing agreements to manufacture generic versions of Roche's antiviral Xofluza (baloxavir marboxil) to improve global access and pandemic preparedness.

* **Administration cancels nearly $1B in HHS funding via rescission authority** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/25/trump-administration-cancel-spending-hhs-programs/)
  * The White House exercised rare statutory authority to claw back nearly $1B in previously approved congressional funding, targeting HHS programs designed for refugees and unaccompanied minors.

* **DOJ halts enforcement of community-based disability care mandates** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/25/health-news-federal-judge-rolls-back-landmark-disability-protections/)
  * A federal judge ruling endorsed a Department of Justice decision to discontinue enforcement of landmark provisions requiring state programs to prioritize community-based care over institutionalization for individuals with disabilities.

* **FDA Commissioner nominee Heidi Overton faces Senate questioning on mifepristone and vaccines** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/25/heidi-overton-confirmation-hearing-mifepristone-abortion-evasive/) | [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/09/25/reticent-fda-commish-nominee-novo-deal/)
  * Senate confirmation hearings for FDA Commissioner nominee Heidi Overton focused on her positions regarding mifepristone oversight, vaccine policy, and supply chain relations with China.

* **Former CDC official highlights ongoing gaps in biothreat preparedness** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/26/anthrax-letters-25th-anniversary-cdc-investigation-new-biothreats-ai/)
  * On the 25th anniversary of the 2001 anthrax letter attacks, public health experts warned of expanding vulnerabilities in national surveillance, rapid response infrastructure, and biothreat mitigation capabilities.

- Biology & Health
    - [Navigating subclinical hypothyroidism | Peter Attia, M.D.](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/6KXdPnGLQrM) -- Peter Attia MD
        - Details Peter Attia's lab-first approach to thyroid symptoms, including the baseline labs checked on all patients and the conditions that frequently masquerade as thyroid disease.
        - Explains that the normal TSH range increases with age, warning that misinterpreting TSH leads to inappropriate treatment of older adults, and notes that mild TSH elevations often resolve without intervention.
        - Identifies accuracy flaws in standard blood tests for free T3 and free T4 during critical diagnostic windows, detailing the additional testing required before confirming a diagnosis.
        - Covers clinical management strategies, including adding T3 when standard T4 therapy normalizes blood work but symptoms persist, and emphasizes medication timing to prevent food from hindering absorption.
        - Examines laboratory testing results on popular thyroid-support supplements while highlighting the specific nutrients that actually impact thyroid function.
- Economics
    - [Is the AI Bubble About to Be Tested?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T-oXyXwD6sE) -- Patrick Boyle
        - Patrick Boyle examines tech sector valuations, contrasting Anthropic's reported $2 trillion IPO plans against Nvidia trading at its cheapest valuation in over a decade.
        - Analyzes macro risks facing AI stocks, specifically how rising interest rates and a 5% ten-year Treasury yield undermine high tech valuations and over-inflated Total Addressable Market (TAM) projections.
        - Highlights potential circular financing loops between Nvidia, OpenAI, and SoftBank, as well as SoftBank's reliance on junk bonds and its $50 billion SB Energy data-center initiative.
        - Discusses margin pressures and price wars in the AI sector triggered by low-cost Chinese open-weight models like DeepSeek.
        - Draws historical parallels to the dotcom bubble, referencing Scott McNealy's warnings about Sun Microsystems to evaluate whether current AI giants risk becoming the next Yahoo or Lycos.
